get.description: Newest 200 machine tokens. Secrets are never returned. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

post.description: Issue an expiring machine token. The secret is returned once and stored only as a SHA-256 digest. Its principal is `machine:{name}`. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

Issue a successor with the same principal and rights. With `overlapSeconds` 0 the old token is revoked; otherwise its expiry is shortened to the overlap. Only an active token can be rotated (`machine_token_inactive`). Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.
Revoke a token. Idempotent; the first reason is retained. Applies to the token's next request. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

get.description: Newest 200 entries of the append-only token audit trail. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

kind.description: content-read issues a connection credential, receipt-write a receipt credential.

secret.description: Returned once. Stored only as a SHA-256 digest.

DeliveryReceiptRequest.description: Unknown fields are rejected, and null counts as absent. The service fills an omitted connectionId, workspaceId, bundleId, channel or digest from the path, the credential's connection and the version before it checks or stores the receipt, so a minimal body and the complete one are the same receipt. revision, resolvedAt and stale are sent together or not at all, channel only with them, and a resolved stage needs them. occurredAt must be no more than 24 hours in the past and 5 minutes in the future, and resolvedAt no more than 5 minutes after occurredAt.

eventId.description: Your ID for this event. Resend the same ID to retry.

connectionId.description: Optional. Taken from the path when omitted, and must match it when sent.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Taken from the path when omitted, and must match it when sent.

bundleId.description: Optional. The connection's bundle when omitted, and must be it when sent.

digest.description: Optional. The version's digest when omitted. The version and digest must have been released on the connection's channel.

source.description: A downloaded stage must use network.

channel.description: Optional. The connection's channel when revision is sent, and must be it when sent.

revision.description: The channel revision the version was resolved at. With the version and digest, it must match a release on the channel.

stale.description: True when the channel mapping came from the local cache because the service could not be reached.

DeliveryReceipt.description: The receipt as received, plus the service's receive time.

delayed.description: Received more than 5 minutes after occurredAt.

details.description: Optional typed metadata, never credential secrets. credential_already_issued carries credentialId, kind and revokedAt.

secretPrefix.description: First 12 characters of the secret, for identification.

lastUsedAt.description: Coarse; updated at most once a minute.

secret.description: Returned once. Never stored or listed.

previous.description: Rotation only: the predecessor after its revocation or shortened expiry.

code.description: The rollout error code: gateway-upstream, provider-rejected, sandbox-start, executor, judge-budget or judge-invalid-reply.

message.description: The executor's redacted message. Always null for a held-out rollout.

failureCause.description: The first failed rollout of the evaluation that ended the round, or of a failed held-out check. Null otherwise.

nextRoundAt.description: When the next round can start. Set only while waiting is daily-cap or provider-unavailable. The provider wait is ten minutes after one provider-unavailable round and doubles for each consecutive one, up to six hours.

evolveTasksNeeded.description: While waiting is no-new-evidence, how many more evolve tasks must be added or changed before the loop runs another round.

optimizerConfigured.description: Whether the service has an optimizer model. Start and resume return 409 optimizer-required without one.

code.description: The rollout error code: gateway-upstream, provider-rejected, sandbox-start, executor, judge-budget or judge-invalid-reply.

message.description: The executor's redacted message. Always null for a held-out rollout.

failureCause.description: The first failed rollout of the evaluation that ended the round, or of a failed held-out check. Null otherwise.

path.description: Affected bundle path, when available and safe to return.

admissionReason.description: Why the task was set aside: reference-failed, empty-passed, judge-unstable, check-failed, or not-converted for an outcome whose conversion failed or set it aside.

input.description: Any JSON value encoded in at most 64 KiB.

expected.description: Any JSON value encoded in at most 64 KiB.

grading.description: How the expected answer is graded. Without it, a non-string answer or a string of at most 80 characters with no line break is graded exact, and a longer answer is graded by criteria the judge model drafts from it. A criteria outcome becomes a task only when that conversion finishes, and input and expected together must then fit in 64 KiB. If the conversion fails for good or sets the row aside, the outcome becomes an exact task set aside with admissionReason not-converted.

taskRevision.description: The revision that added the task. For an outcome graded by criteria, the current revision when the outcome was accepted: its task is added later, once conversion drafts the criteria.
